bug_semantics: PMD turns attacker-influenced rule-violation text into HTML reports. In the `vbhtml` path, a crafted source literal can flow into `RuleViolation.getDescription()`, which `VBHTMLRenderer.renderFileViolations` appended inside a `<td>` without HTML escaping. `YAHTMLRenderer` likewise passed the description as the unescaped `value` of `renderViolationRow`, and the default `HTMLRenderer` separately emitted an unescaped suppression user message. Opening a generated report therefore lets injected tags and event-handler JavaScript execute in the report viewer's browser context.
flaw_origin: The earliest and smallest repository commit that created the affected missing-output-encoding design is 0be90c05aa2e3c9e0c75ea91b63d84c22dbe6605. It added `pmd/src/net/sourceforge/pmd/renderers/VBHTMLRenderer.java` from scratch and directly concatenated `rv.getDescription()` between HTML tags. Its immediate parent has no such file or line. Later YAHTMLRenderer and HTML suppression code added parallel sinks, but they do not precede this root BIC; moves, renderer refactors, and the subsequent 20f2bb867730424aa1cb3f4c9459baab9b7165c3 cleanup preserved rather than originated the vulnerable VB sink.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names human author and committer Tom Copeland; its message is `Added VBHTMLRenderer; thanks to Vladimir Bossicard for the code.` and its only body metadata is the `git-svn-id: https://pmd.svn.sourceforge.net/svnroot/pmd/trunk@1946 51baf565-9d33-0410-a72c-fc3788e3496d` line. It has no bot identity and no `Co-Authored-By`, `Generated-with`, or other AI trailer.

BIC object and patch: https://github.com/pmd/pmd/commit/0be90c05aa2e3c9e0c75ea91b63d84c22dbe6605 — full-file addition at `pmd/src/net/sourceforge/pmd/renderers/VBHTMLRenderer.java`; added line 50 is `sb.append("" + rv.getDescription() + "");`. The same object gives parent c6167c00d716274ff60cad550a8a4210083efd69, author/committer Tom Copeland, and only the git-svn-id body metadata.

Direct-parent verification: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmd/pmd/c6167c00d716274ff60cad550a8a4210083efd69/pmd/src/net/sourceforge/pmd/renderers/VBHTMLRenderer.java returns 404, while the BIC diff records the path as ADDED from `/dev/null`/`oldTreeEntry: null`. Thus the vulnerable file and description-to-HTML line are absent in the immediate parent tree.

The next commit, https://github.com/pmd/pmd/commit/20f2bb867730424aa1cb3f4c9459baab9b7165c3, only restructures iteration/buffer initialization and retains that sink, confirming it is not the BIC.

reasoning: The advisory's concrete attack path was traced backward from the vulnerable VBHTML output statement. Commit 0be90c05aa2e3c9e0c75ea91b63d84c22dbe6605 is smaller and causally earlier than every refactor or path move because it creates the renderer and the exact unescaped description append in one file-add patch. Its direct parent c6167c00d716274ff60cad550a8a4210083efd69 lacks the path, independently confirmed by the added-file diff and parent-tree raw lookup. Although the advisory's final fix also covers later parallel YAHTMLRenderer and HTML suppression sinks, those do not displace the earliest class root in VBHTMLRenderer. The vulnerable statement survives in the last affected 7.21.0 tag. Direct patch commit 96598aa6c4b42cf13b2b4b20d8c29d2bc680ecd0 introduces contextual HTML escaping, and merge commit c140c0e1de5853a08efb84c9f91dfeb015882442 lands it before the 7.22.0 tag, whose source and release notes confirm the fixed boundary. Finally, BIC-only attribution finds no AI commit-object marker: the 2003 BIC is authored and committed by Tom Copeland, credits Vladimir Bossicard in ordinary human text, and contains only SVN migration metadata. The causal and attribution evidence therefore closes as NOT_AI.
